title: Project scaffold: Vite + TypeScript + Vitest + CI
body:
Set up the repo for the production build.

- Vite + TypeScript (strict), ESLint + Prettier, Vitest
- Folder layout from `docs/CODER_PROMPT.md` §2 (`src/sim`, `src/ui`, `tests`)
- npm scripts: `dev`, `build`, `test`, `lint`, `sim`
- GitHub Actions workflow running lint, test and build on every push and PR
- `.gitignore` for node_modules, dist, .env

**Done when:** a fresh clone runs `npm ci && npm test && npm run build` green, and CI passes on the PR.

title: Balance data module (data.ts)
body:
Single source of truth for every balance number (spec §3.2, §3.4).

- Piece stats: cost, tier, HP, ATK, action speed
- Star multipliers (HP 1/1.9/3.5, ATK 1/1.8/3.3) and ability values
- Pool sizes, tier odds per level, XP table, income/interest/streak values, fight limits (26 idle ticks, 220 max)

**Done when:** no balance number appears anywhere else in `src/`.

title: Seeded RNG
body:
Deterministic RNG (e.g. mulberry32) carried in game state. No `Math.random` inside `src/sim`.

- `next()`, `int(n)`, `shuffle(arr)`
- Serializable state so a match can be saved and resumed

**Done when:** same seed gives the same sequence; tested.

title: Board geometry: wall, portals and move generation
body:
Implement spec §3.1 and the movement column of §3.2.

- 16×8 world grid, wall between x=7 and x=8, portal squares (7,2) (7,5) (8,2) (8,5)
- A step across the wall is legal only if it starts or ends on a portal square; sliders check every step
- Knights leap the wall anywhere
- Move generation for Pawn (forward / diagonal-forward by side), Knight, Bishop, Rook, Queen

**Tests:** rook h5→i5 blocked; rook h6 slides through to i6 and beyond; bishop g7→h6→i5 legal; knight g4→i5 legal; pawns only move toward the enemy.

title: Strike generation
body:
Which enemies a piece can hit from a square.

- Pawn: the 3 squares ahead (side-aware), respecting the wall
- Knight: knight squares
- Bishop / Rook / Queen: along their lines, up to 3 squares, first piece blocks line of sight

**Tests:** range cap of 3; line of sight blocked by friend or foe; wall blocks non-portal strikes.

title: Battle simulation tick loop
body:
Spec §3.3.

- Build battle units from both boards with star-scaled stats
- Cooldowns with random first action (seeded); shuffled act order per tick
- Strike lowest-HP enemy in range; damage = round(ATK × mult × (1 − armor)), min 1
- On a kill the attacker moves onto the target's square
- Emit an event list (move, strike, heal, death, portal-cross) for the renderer and log

**Done when:** same seed + armies produce an identical event log (test).

title: Pathfinding: BFS on each piece's own move graph
body:
When no enemy is in range, move along the shortest path (in the piece's own chess moves, current occupancy) to the nearest square it could strike from.

- Fallback: legal move that most reduces wall-aware king-step distance to the nearest enemy
- Otherwise wait 1 tick

**Tests:** a rook routes through a portal row; a bishop crosses via a portal diagonal; a blocked pawn waits.

title: Star abilities (2★ / 3★)
body:
- Pawn Shield Wall: 15% / 30% less damage with an orthogonally adjacent friend
- Knight Fork: also hits 1 / all other enemies on its knight squares
- Bishop Blessing: heals most wounded ally for 60% / 120% ATK, never above max HP
- Rook Fortress: 20% / 35% less damage
- Queen Pierce: hits the enemy directly behind the target for 50% / 100%

**Done when:** each ability has a unit test at 1★ (off), 2★ and 3★.

title: Fight end conditions and material tiebreak
body:
- Ends when one side has no pieces
- Ends after 26 ticks with no damage, or at 220 ticks: winner by remaining material Σ cost × 3^(stars−1) × hp/maxHp; exact tie is a draw

**Tests:** every random battle in a 1,000-battle fuzz ends within 220 ticks.

title: Shared piece pool and shop rolling
body:
Spec §3.4.

- Pool shared by both players: Pawn 30, Knight 18, Bishop 18, Rook 14, Queen 9
- 5-slot shop rolled with tier odds by level; empty tier falls back to the nearest tier with stock
- Reroll (2g) returns unbought cards to the pool; free roll each round unless locked; lock lasts one round

**Test:** total piece count (pool + shops + benches + boards) is conserved across buy/sell/reroll.

title: Buy, sell, bench and 3-copy merging
body:
- 8-slot bench; buy blocked on a full bench unless the buy completes a merge
- 3 same type + stars → one piece a star higher, kept where a copy stood (board copy preferred); merges chain to 3★
- Sell refunds cost × 3^(stars−1) and returns that many copies to the pool

**Tests:** 3×1★ → 2★; 9×1★ bought in sequence → 3★; full-bench merge buy; merged piece keeps its board square.

title: Economy: income, interest, streaks, XP and levels
body:
- Round 1: 3 gold. Then base min(5, round+2) + interest floor(gold/10) (max 5) + streak bonus (2–3:+1, 4–5:+2, 6+:+3) + 1 for last-round win
- Level 2–8; board cap = level; XP needs 2/4/6/10/14/20; +1 XP per round from round 2; Buy XP 4g for 4 XP

**Tests:** income breakdown, interest cap, streak bonus, level-ups, board cap enforced.

title: Round flow state machine and HP damage
body:
`prep → handoff → combat → result → next round | game over` (spec §3.5).

- Player HP 50; loser takes 2 + surviving winner stars + floor(round/4); draw costs both 2
- Supports vs-AI and local 2-player modes

**Done when:** a full match can be played headlessly through the state machine.

title: AI opponent: shopping, leveling and placement
body:
Spec §3.6. Same rules as a human, no hidden information.

- Buy matching copies first; level toward min(8, 2 + floor((round+1)/2)); fill army with best affordable piece; keep 10g for interest from round 6; reroll up to twice with 16+ gold from round 5
- Formation: pawns on portal lanes, knights behind, rooks and queen middle, bishops back
- Difficulty parameter: easy / normal / hard

title: Headless balance runner (npm run sim)
body:
`npm run sim -- --games 500 [--seed N]` plays AI-vs-AI matches and prints:

- win rate by side (target: neither above 55%)
- average match length in rounds
- how often each piece and star level appears in winning armies

Add a CI test running 200 mirrored games that fails above 55% for either side.

title: Balance pass 1
body: Run `npm run sim` and post results in this issue. Propose at least 3 number changes in `data.ts` backed by the data (piece over/under-performing, match length, economy pacing). Apply the agreed changes in a PR.

title: Canvas renderer: boards, wall, portals, pieces
body:
- Two boards (warm squares for Ivory, sage for Ebony), wall gap, pulsing portal squares and bridges, a–p / 1–8 notation
- Pieces drawn with ♟♞♝♜♛ + U+FE0E in Noto Sans Symbols 2, outline, shadow, stars, HP bar in combat
- Responsive: side-by-side on desktop, stacked vertically under ~620px with input mapping following the rotation
- HiDPI crisp; colors from CSS custom properties; respects prefers-reduced-motion

title: Combat animation, effects and speed controls
body:
Drive animation from the sim's event list.

- Smooth moves, knight hop arc, strike lines in the attacker's color, floating damage/heal numbers, death ring + fade
- 1× / 2× / 4× speed and Skip to result

title: HUD: scoreboard, shop, bench, actions
body:
- Scoreboard: HP bar, gold, level, XP, streak for both players (gold hidden from the other player during hot-seat prep)
- Shop cards with tier-colored edge, cost, pips for copies owned; tier odds line
- Reroll, Lock, Buy XP, Sell (shows refund), Fight/Ready
- Bench of 8 slots and an "On board X/level" counter

title: Tap-to-place piece placement
body: Tap a piece (bench or board), then tap a square on your own board or a bench slot. Tapping two pieces swaps them. Highlight open squares while a bench piece is selected. Block placement past the board cap with a clear message. Works with touch.

title: Overlays and hot-seat privacy
body:
- Start screen (vs AI / 2 players on one screen)
- Handoff screen before each player's prep in hot-seat; opponent's board fogged during prep
- Round result with damage breakdown; game-over screen with New war

title: Battle log in chess notation and field manual
body:
- Log kills (e.g. `♞ c3×e4 Bishop falls`), portal crossings, merges and round results
- Field manual panel listing every piece's cost, stats, movement and star ability, generated from `data.ts`

title: Drag-and-drop placement
body: Pointer-event drag between bench and board (mouse and touch), with a ghost piece and drop highlighting. Tap-to-place stays as the fallback.

title: Save and resume a match
body: Save the full game state (including RNG state) to localStorage at the start of each prep phase. Offer Continue on the start screen. Wrap every storage call in try/catch and play normally if storage is unavailable.

title: Sound effects with mute toggle
body: Buy, merge, strike, death, portal crossing, round win/loss. Audio starts only after a user interaction. Mute toggle remembered per browser.

title: Deploy to the Game Portal
body:
- Document deploying `dist/` as static files
- Test on staging (NixonExpress) before promoting to the live Game Portal server
- Add a deploy section to the README

title: Online 1v1: authoritative WebSocket server
body:
Small Node + WebSocket server that owns the RNG seed, pool and battle sim using the shared `src/sim` code unchanged.

- Clients send intents only: buy, sell, reroll, lock, buyXP, place, ready
- Server validates every intent and never trusts client state
- Server sends state updates and the battle event list

title: Online lobby: room codes and reconnect
body: Create/join a room with a short code, ready-up, and rejoin a match after a disconnect (state resent on reconnect). Handle a player leaving (forfeit after a timeout).

title: Client network layer and online mode UI
body: Add an Online mode to the start screen. Route shop/placement actions to the server when online, render server-sent state and battle events with the existing renderer, show connection status.

title: Art direction and style guide
body:
Decide the game's look before any final assets are made. Everything else in the Art milestone depends on this.

- Pick a rendering style (e.g. flat vector, painted 2D, pixel art, or pre-rendered 3D) and show 2–3 mood boards
- Lock the palette as design tokens (Ivory side, Ebony side, portal, brass accent, UI neutrals, tier colors T1–T4)
- Typography: display face for the logo and headings, body face, mono face for notation and numbers
- Rules for readability: a piece must be recognizable at 28 px on a phone

**Done when:** `docs/art/STYLE_GUIDE.md` is merged with palette, fonts, sample piece and sample board square.

title: Chess piece sprites: 5 pieces × 2 sides
body:
Final art for Pawn, Knight, Bishop, Rook and Queen in Ivory and Ebony.

- SVG (preferred) or PNG at 1×, 2×, 3×; transparent background; consistent base line and bounding box
- Readable at 28 px and crisp at 128 px
- Ivory and Ebony must both read clearly on both board colors
- Replace the Unicode glyphs in the renderer behind a single `pieceSprite(type, side)` function

**Done when:** all 10 sprites are in `assets/pieces/` and render in-game.

title: Star-level visuals (1★, 2★, 3★)
body:
Make star level obvious at a glance, not only from the ★ row.

- Treatment per level (e.g. bronze / silver / gold trim, plinth, glow)
- Star pips under the piece that stay legible at small sizes
- Works for both sides and all 5 pieces

title: Board tiles, wall and notation
body:
- Light and dark squares for each board (Ivory board warm, Ebony board cool), tileable and subtle so pieces stay readable
- The wall between the boards, with its end caps
- File/rank notation style (a–p, 1–8)
- Optional board frame and table surface around the battlefield
- Must also work in the stacked (vertical) phone layout

title: Portal squares and bridge
body:
The signature element of the game.

- Portal square art for (h6, h3, i6, i3) and the bridge across the wall
- Idle loop animation (sprite sheet or shader-friendly layers), plus a still frame for reduced motion
- A short burst when a piece passes through

title: Combat VFX: strikes, damage, death, heal
body:
- Strike effect per piece type (pawn jab, knight leap impact, bishop / rook / queen line strike), tinted by side
- Hit flash, floating damage and heal number style
- Death effect (piece shatters or topples and fades)
- Ability effects: Shield Wall, Fork, Blessing, Fortress, Pierce
- Deliver as sprite sheets with frame timings, or as parameters for canvas effects

title: Merge and level-up effects
body:
- Effect when 3 copies merge into a higher star level (on bench and on board)
- Player level-up effect in the HUD
- Shop buy feedback

title: Shop cards and tier frames
body:
- Card frame for each tier (T1–T4) with cost badge and piece art
- States: normal, hover, unaffordable, bought/empty, locked shop
- Pips showing copies already owned

title: HUD and UI kit
body:
- Buttons (primary, secondary, disabled, toggle), panels, scoreboard with HP bar, gold, level/XP bar, streak badge
- Bench slots (empty, filled, selected), speed control, tooltips
- Icon set: gold, XP, HP, reroll, lock, sell, sound on/off, settings
- Provide as SVG + a component sheet matching the style guide tokens

title: Logo, title screen and overlays
body:
- Chess War logo (wordmark + small mark)
- Start screen composition
- Handoff screen, round result and game-over screens, win and lose variants

title: App icon and favicon
body: Favicon (16, 32, 48 px) and app icons (180, 192, 512 px, plus maskable) from the logo mark. Add the web manifest entries.

title: Art integration and asset pipeline
body:
- `assets/` folder layout and naming conventions
- Sprite atlas or SVG sprite build step in Vite; preload with a loading screen
- Keep the Unicode-glyph renderer as a fallback if assets fail to load
- Budget: total art download under 2 MB on first load

**Done when:** swapping an asset file updates the game with no code changes.

title: Bug report template and triage process
body:
- Add `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml`: steps to reproduce, expected vs actual, seed/round, device and browser, screenshot
- Severity labels: `sev:blocker`, `sev:major`, `sev:minor`, `sev:cosmetic`
- Weekly triage: every new bug gets a severity and a milestone

title: Bug check: battle simulation fuzz test
body:
Run 10,000 random armies through the sim (seeded).

- [ ] Every battle ends within 220 ticks
- [ ] No piece ever stands on another piece or outside the grid
- [ ] No non-knight crosses the wall except via a portal square
- [ ] HP never above max or below 0; heals never exceed max
- [ ] Same seed replays identically

File a bug for each failure with its seed.

title: Bug check: economy and shop invariants
body:
- [ ] Pool count conserved through buy, sell, reroll, lock and merge (property test)
- [ ] Gold never negative; buy blocked when unaffordable
- [ ] Board never exceeds level; bench never exceeds 8
- [ ] Merges chain correctly and never lose or duplicate a piece
- [ ] Income, interest and streak math matches the spec for 30 rounds

title: Bug check: UI across browsers and devices
body:
Play one full match on each and log issues:

- [ ] Chrome, Firefox, Edge on Windows
- [ ] Safari on iPhone, Chrome on Android (portrait and landscape)
- [ ] Desktop at 1280 px and 1920 px
- [ ] No horizontal page scroll; board fits; taps land on the right square in both layouts
- [ ] No console errors

title: Bug check: hot-seat privacy and round flow
body:
- [ ] The other player's board, bench, shop and gold stay hidden during prep
- [ ] Handoff screen shows before every prep
- [ ] Skip, speed change and result screens never get stuck or double-advance a round
- [ ] Game over triggers on 0 HP for either or both players

title: Bug check: save/resume and storage failures
body:
- [ ] Resume restores gold, shop, bench, board, pool, RNG and round exactly
- [ ] Corrupt or old-version save is discarded safely with a message
- [ ] Game plays normally in a private window or with storage blocked

title: Bug check: performance
body:
- [ ] 60 fps during combat with 16 pieces on a mid-range phone
- [ ] `npm run sim -- --games 500` finishes in under 60 s
- [ ] First load under 3 s on home Wi-Fi; no memory growth over a 20-round match

title: Bug check: accessibility
body:
- [ ] All controls reachable and usable by keyboard with visible focus
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA
- [ ] Sides distinguishable without relying on color alone
- [ ] Reduced-motion setting respected

title: Bug check: online desync and cheating
body:
- [ ] Forged or out-of-turn intents (extra gold, over board cap, other player's pieces) are rejected by the server
- [ ] Both clients show identical battle results
- [ ] Disconnect and reconnect mid-prep and mid-battle recovers state
- [ ] Two rooms at once never share state

title: CI build artifacts
body: GitHub Actions uploads `dist/` as a downloadable build artifact on every PR and on main, named with the commit SHA. Keep 14 days.

title: Preview deploy for every PR
body: Deploy each PR build to a preview URL on the staging box (NixonExpress), comment the link on the PR, remove it when the PR closes.

title: Keep the shareable prototype artifact in sync
body: The single-file `prototype/chess-war.html` (also published as a Claude artifact) stays playable. Update it when core rules change, until the production build replaces it. Note the rules version at the top of the file.

title: Release artifacts: versioned zip and changelog
body: Tag releases `vX.Y.Z`; a workflow attaches `chess-war-vX.Y.Z.zip` (static build) to the GitHub Release. Maintain `CHANGELOG.md`.

title: Playable demo build
body: A short, polished slice for showing people: vs-AI only, 5 rounds, a guided first round (tooltips for shop, placement, portals, merging), and an end screen inviting a full game. Toggle via a `?demo` URL flag or build flag.

title: Demo media: GIFs, screenshots and trailer
body:
- 3 GIFs: a portal crossing, a 3★ merge, a full fight at 2×
- 5 screenshots (desktop and phone)
- 30–60 s gameplay trailer
- Add GIFs to the README

title: Demo day script
body: A 5-minute walkthrough for showing Chess War to friends: pitch line, one round played live, key mechanics to point out, and 3 feedback questions to ask.

title: Alpha gate checker
body:
Alpha = feature-complete core, played by the two admins.

- [ ] M1 and M2 closed; M3 UI playable end to end
- [ ] All M1–M2 bug checks pass
- [ ] No open `sev:blocker`
- [ ] vs AI and hot-seat both finish a full match
- [ ] Style guide merged (Art)
- [ ] Build deployed to staging

Close this issue to declare Alpha.

title: Alpha playtest: 10 internal matches
body: Nixon and Connor play 10 matches (5 vs AI, 5 hot-seat) on staging. File bugs with seeds. Record: match length, favourite and least-used pieces, confusing moments.

title: Alpha feedback review and fix list
body: Group Alpha feedback into must-fix for Beta, nice-to-have and won't-fix. Create or link issues for each must-fix.

title: Beta gate checker
body:
Beta = content complete with final art, opened to outside testers.

- [ ] M3 and M4 closed; final piece, board and portal art in game
- [ ] All Alpha must-fix issues closed
- [ ] Browser/device, save, performance and accessibility bug checks pass
- [ ] No open `sev:blocker` or `sev:major`
- [ ] Balance: neither side above 55% over 500 sim games

Close this issue to declare Beta.

title: Beta test with 5–10 outside players
body: Share the staging build with friends. Provide a short feedback form (fun 1–5, clarity 1–5, bugs, best moment, worst moment). Run for 2 weeks.

title: Balance pass 2 from Beta data
body: Combine Beta feedback with `npm run sim` results; adjust `data.ts`; re-run bug checks for sim and economy.

title: Onboarding and tutorial polish
body: Use Beta feedback to fix the top 3 confusing moments (likely portals, merging, board cap). Add first-round tooltips if not already in the demo build.

title: Launch gate checker
body:
- [ ] Beta must-fix issues closed; no open `sev:blocker` or `sev:major`
- [ ] Full bug-check pass on the release candidate
- [ ] Release `v1.0.0` tagged with zip artifact and changelog
- [ ] Rollback plan tested
- [ ] Logo, favicon and title screen final
- [ ] Connor signs off on the live server deploy

Close this issue to launch.

title: Deploy v1.0 to the live Game Portal
body: Promote the tested staging build to the live Game Portal server. Verify with a full match on desktop and phone after deploy.

title: Rollback plan
body: Keep the previous release zip on the live server; document the one-command rollback; test it once on staging before launch.

title: Launch announcement and release notes
body: Release notes from `CHANGELOG.md`, a Game Portal listing with screenshots/GIF, and a short message for players.

title: Post-launch hotfix window
body: Two weeks after launch: daily bug triage, fast patch releases (`v1.0.x`) for any blocker, then a retrospective issue listing what to do in v1.1 (online play, new pieces, alliances).

title: Build and maintain the README
body:
The README is the front door of the repo. Build it out now and keep it current for the life of the project.

**Build**
- [ ] What Chess War is, with a screenshot or GIF
- [ ] How to play the prototype and the current build
- [ ] Rules summary with a link to the full spec
- [ ] Setup: `npm ci`, `npm run dev`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run sim`
- [ ] Project layout
- [ ] How to tune balance in `data.ts`
- [ ] How to deploy to staging and the live Game Portal
- [ ] Roadmap with links to each milestone, and the current stage (pre-Alpha / Alpha / Beta / Launched)
- [ ] How to report a bug (link to the bug template)

**Maintain**
- [ ] Add a PR template checkbox: "README updated if setup, rules, scripts or layout changed"
- [ ] Update the stage and roadmap when each Alpha / Beta / Launch gate checker closes
- [ ] Refresh screenshots and GIFs when the Art milestone lands
- [ ] Review the README at every release tag

Keep this issue open until Launch; close it with the v1.0 README review.

title: HUD: show On Board and the bench above the shop
body:
Swap the two halves of the dock. The `On board X/level` label and the bench row come first, directly under the scoreboard, and the shop header (gold, odds) with its five cards sits below them. The action row (reroll, lock, buy XP, sell, fight) stays at the bottom.

- Reorder the dock children in `src/ui/hud.ts`; no model changes
- Keep tap-to-place, drag-and-drop and the merge / buy feedback working
- Check the phone layout (390px) still fits without the shop pushing the bench off screen

**Done when:** in prep the bench is visibly above the shop on desktop and phone, and lint, tests and build pass.

title: Show the combat controls only during a fight
body:
The row with `1× 2× 4×`, `Skip to result` and `Sound on/off` is visible on the start screen and all through prep, where none of it does anything. Hide the whole row unless a fight is playing.

- Toggle the `.controls` row from the same refresh that shows and hides overlays; it appears when combat playback starts and disappears when the result is shown
- Prep, handoff, start, result and game-over screens show no combat controls
- The sound preference still persists; the toggle is simply only reachable while a fight plays

**Done when:** the row is absent on the start screen and during prep, present during combat, and lint, tests and build pass.

title: Shop card names are clipped by the cost badge on narrow screens
body:
At widths around 580px and below, the five shop cards shrink until the round cost badge sits on top of the piece name, so "Pawn" reads as "awn" and "Bishop" as "ishop". Seen in the stacked (phone) layout during prep.

- Give the card footer room for both the badge and the name (wrap to two lines, shrink the badge, or drop the pips onto their own row) below a breakpoint
- Check 390px and 580px widths, with 1★, 2★ and 3★ pip counts
- Keep the tier colour strip and the "Bought" state as they are

**Done when:** every piece name is fully readable on every card at 390px and 580px, and lint, tests and build pass.
